mapper.select: select Q.QUEST_ID as questId, Q.USER_ID as userId, Q.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, Q.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, Q.TRANSACTION_ID as transactionId, Q.QUEST_TITLE as displayName, Q.QUEST_DEADLINE as questDeadline, Q.QUEST_STATUS as questStatus, Q.QUEST_URL as questUrl, Q.QUEST_COMPLETED_AT as questCompletedAt from QUEST Q where Q.USER_ID = #{userId} order by Q.QUEST_ID asc
